final_message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The cause is in the vendored `slugify`, which deletes any character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters were dropped instead of reduced to their base letter. That folder says not to edit it by hand, so I made the change in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. `postSlug` now strips the accents before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) use the same vendored `slugify` and still drop accented letters. I left them alone since you only asked about blog posts. The same one-line approach would fix them if you want it.
